recognize_zh: 淋巴結低倍下，淡粉紅色的淋巴竇明顯擴張，內含大量細胞質豐富、淡染的大型組織球，與深藍色、密集的淋巴球／漿細胞帶交錯，形成明暗相間的圖案；這種竇擴張表現是 Rosai-Dorfman 病的特徵。
features: Markedly dilated sinuses appearing as pale pink zones at low power
Sinuses filled with large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Alternating dark bands of densely packed lymphocytes and plasma cells in intersinusoidal cords
Light-dark alternating pattern across the node
Congested vessels and hemorrhage at the periphery; no necrosis
describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows marked dilatation of sinuses, which appear as pale zones filled with large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. These alternate with dark intersinusoidal cords of densely packed lymphocytes and plasma cells, producing a light-dark pattern. No necrosis or granulomas are seen. Findings are suggestive of Rosai-Dorfman disease (sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy), with confirmation by emperipolesis and S100-positive, CD1a-negative histiocytes.

ddx.vs: Reactive sinus histiocytosis shows less dramatic sinus expansion with smaller S100-negative histiocytes lacking emperipolesis.
LCH also involves sinuses but contains grooved cells with eosinophil microabscesses and necrosis, and is CD1a/langerin-positive.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma in sinuses
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumor cells are cohesive and atypical and express keratin or SOX10 rather than CD68/CD163.
ALCL shows sinusoidal pleomorphic hallmark cells that are CD30-positive, often with ALK.
